processing: Extract this complete ground-cart line without changing any bytes. No UAV pairing, coordinate perturbation, resampling or padding.
Read all 312 traces and 494 samples with segyio; process with GPRPy sample-index operators only unless independently supported sampling metadata becomes available.

author_reader.scope: Reader supplies amplitudes and sample-index plots; no physical sample-time calibration.

limitations: Digital amplitude units are uncalibrated; zero is retained as a valid reading.
Unknown radar time scaling, coordinate units, horizontal CRS and vertical datum prohibit a field depth or velocity claim.
No field ground truth, reflector labels, amplitude/timing error budget or joint interpretation.
